summary: CP2 death = a deliberate air U-turn; the human flies ~1 s more east to a ramp and turns on it. Built --noise-tau (AR(1)-correlated sampling noise, per-decision distribution and log-prob unchanged), --noise-tau-frac, --noise-tau-cond (exact conditional credit, CPU-tested only). Best: warm incumbent -> ratchet + noise-tau on 25% of envs + unstuck T heated to 2: the GREEDY policy learns the CP2 detour (east, ramp turn, climb back over the old death point), 28.49 at 1.279B (incumbent 27.22). All-env noise runs the KL away. The detour is dropped within 75M steps by every continuation (it costs ~2 units of time penalty for ~1 unit of progress until the post-detour section pays); a 64-bin backward-window spawn curriculum teaches that section (training reaches 32.46%, past sgcp_2). Next: combine both at moderate T or with --noise-tau-cond, on a faster box (this one ran 69k steps/s).
